### New brushes

The collection includes 31 more image stamps, refreshed Chalk, Charcoal and Fern tips, and eight paintbrush presets.

Round Paint, Flat Paint, Filbert and Dense Fan give fuller coverage. Dry Bristle, Dry Fan and Rake leave connected strands, while Bristle Wash gives a lighter coat. New settings control paint load, texture, spread and direction response. Each paintbrush remembers its own settings, while colour, size and blend mode stay shared.

### Brush browser

A category sidebar replaces the button grid, with a single selector in narrow windows. Favourites and Recent make brushes easier to reach, and paintbrush cards show a sample stroke. Search, keyboard navigation and the New button have clearer places in the layout.

Preview size, spacing, colours and corners can be adjusted in Preferences. The browser follows the main theme unless you choose overrides.

### Compact controls

Opacity and Flow remain available in Brush settings, keeping the ordinary toolbar smaller. Preferences can show them in the toolbar, and paintbrush presets can show their recommended controls automatically.

Custom tips can still override bundled brushes. Removing an override restores the original tip. The new brush guide covers the presets, controls and custom stamps.
